_help: Act 3, the final approach (every route, then Act 4): the rivals in sight (Germans start at race_step 4, Americans at 5; ties go to the rival), Whitfield's wager if not offered on the boat (wager_offered / wager_accepted), and Youssef's shortcut: with his trust >= 1 it wins the race (race_step 3), else it costs you (race_step 5). The Act 4 draft reads race_step. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: The last stretch. Dust on the horizon: we aren't alone out here.

rivals.speaker: player
rivals.line: German trucks to the north, keeping a hard pace, and further back the Americans' column.

whit_rides.speaker: whitfield
whit_rides.line: Hey there, neighbour! Charlie Whitfield. Five hundred dollars says we beat you to the ruins. What do you say?

whit_yes.speaker: whitfield
whit_yes.line: Ha! See you at the finish, pal!

youssef_offer.speaker: youssef
youssef_offer.line: There is a dry wash that cuts across to the ruins. Nobody uses it. Trust me and we will be there before the Germans!

shortcut_good.speaker: youssef
shortcut_good.line: There! The ruins! And no German dust in front of us!

shortcut_bad.speaker: youssef
shortcut_bad.line: It... the wash ends in a cliff. I am sorry. I am so sorry. We must go back.

arrive.speaker: player
arrive.line: Akmentar. Broken columns in the sand, and somewhere beneath them, the tombs.
